centroid: analytic native binary SEG centroid; inv(T_est) @ S @ c, not clinical TRE
cnr: fixed CT-grid ROI, shell excluding all annotated SEG and CT <= -350; common finite samples across all tests/methods; sample SD; native PET comparison has different sampling
note: No SUV conversion. SEG annotations are research references, not independent CT landmarks. CNR shell is not guaranteed homogeneous tissue. Native vs CT grid differs in sample counts.
